newsitem.title: UK: Investcorp looking for finance - banker.
newsitem.headline: Investcorp looking for finance - banker.

text.p: Bahrain-based Investcorp is looking at a number of ways to finance its acquisition of a chain of British motorway service stations, an official at Bankers Trust said on Thursday.
Earlier the Evening Standard newspaper said Investcorp could raise up to 350 million stg through a bond issue backed by the cashflows and assets of the Welcome Break chain.
"Investcorp with Welcome Break is considering a number of financing options, but that is all we are able to say at the moment," an official at Bankers Trust, advisor to Investcorp, told Reuters.
Investcorp paid Granada Plc 476 million stg for Welcome Break in February.
